title: Marin Brand Center brand.json
description: Schema for one brand under brands/<slug>/brand.json. Extracted from the real County of Marin brand.json (originally marin-docs/brand/brand-center.json), not written in the abstract — see brands/county-of-marin/brand.json for a filled-out example and templates/brand.template.json for a starting point. Source-citation fields (page/section references back to an extracted PDF) are optional throughout: this schema has to fit a future brand authored directly, not just one extracted from a print guide.

status.description: Free text describing this data's provenance/review state, e.g. 'published', 'source-derived-draft'. Not read by scripts/build-brand.js — it does not drive any rendering.

name.description: Rendered in the page title, breadcrumb, and directory card.

website.description: Optional. The brand's own website, shown as 'Website: <link>' under the description. Omit to hide the line.

lastUpdated.description: Free-text date shown under the title, e.g. 'September 30, 2026'. Omit to hide that line.

sourceUpdated.description: Only meaningful when this brand was extracted from a dated source document.

sourceFile.description: Relative path; only its basename is used, to link to a matching file under this brand's source-documents/. For a brand whose canonical guide is a live webpage rather than an archived file, use sourceUrl instead.

sourceUrl.description: Link to this brand's canonical guide when it's a live webpage rather than an archived PDF (sourceFile). Rendered as an extra Source link.

preferred.description: First preferred:true variant is used as the directory-card thumbnail.

preview.description: Path relative to this brand's own folder, e.g. assets/reference-previews/primary-logo-reference.png.

previewBackground.description: Set to 'dark' to show the preview on a dark card (for white or reversed artwork). Variants whose id contains 'reversed' get a dark card automatically.

downloads.description: Optional. Files offered in the Download menu, e.g. SVG and PNG. Without it, the preview file is the only download.

file.description: Path relative to this brand's own folder.

label.description: Menu label. Defaults to the file extension in capitals.

digitalImplementation.description: How this brand's identity is actually implemented on MarinOS digital products, when it diverges from the print guide — see marin-digital-standards/brand/typography.md for why that divergence is expected, not a compromise.

qrCodeLogos.description: Optional. Shown under Logos. Logos made for the center of a QR code, such as in Marin Links. A square PNG works best. Mark one item as the default.

default.description: True for the logo a tool should use unless told otherwise.

preview.description: Path to a square PNG under this brand's assets/ folder.

illustrations.description: Optional. Supporting scene/concept illustrations distinct from logos — for a brand whose materials include outreach graphics beyond the mark itself.

preview.description: Optional — omit if no local preview file exists yet; the card renders without an image.

printMaterials.description: Optional. Print-ready materials (posters, flyers) distributed as a linked document rather than a direct downloadable image.

url.description: Link to the material — may be an external page, not necessarily a direct file.

socialMedia.description: Optional. Ready-to-post social assets paired with suggested caption copy, potentially in multiple languages.

downloadUrl.description: Only set if different from preview (e.g. preview is a mockup, downloadUrl is the flat asset).

language.description: e.g. 'en', 'es' — used as a key, not rendered directly.

languageLabel.description: e.g. 'English', 'Spanish' — what's actually rendered as the heading.

citation.description: Optional source-document citation. Shape varies (page vs pages, section vs sections, an extra option label) because the underlying print guide's own structure varies — this is provenance for a human reading the JSON, not something scripts/build-brand.js depends on.
